scenes.headline: How one model sees and draws without encoders
scenes.sub: SenseNova-U1.5, built on NEO-unify: patches in, patches out.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Glacier! Most unified models bolt a vision encoder on one end and a VAE on the other. SenseNova-U1.5 removes both. Here's how.

scenes.text: Images go in as patch embeddings and come out as patch embeddings, through the same backbone as the words. No pre-trained encoder or decoder.
scenes.mark: the same backbone as the words
scenes.say: Images go in as patch embeddings and come out as patch embeddings, through the same backbone as the words. No pre-trained encoder, and no pre-trained decoder.

left.title: The usual stack
items: A vision encoder turns pixels into tokens
A language model in the middle
A VAE decodes latents to pixels
left.say: The usual stack has two separately trained pieces: an encoder so the model can see, and a VAE so it can draw. Both impose a representation.

right.title: NEO-unify
items: One backbone for words and pixels
right.say: NEO-unify drops both, so the model shapes one representation space itself.

steps.say: To understand, image patches enter beside word embeddings. No vision encoder decides what the model sees.

steps.note: understanding and generation branches share attention
steps.say: To draw, noisy patches enter the same Mixture-of-Transformer, whose understanding and generation branches share attention.
Text leaves by cross-entropy. Pixels leave by flow matching, as patches again. Nothing decodes a latent.

scenes.title: Reconstruction on MS COCO 2017, PSNR
scenes.say: Doesn't losing the VAE cost fidelity? At two billion parameters, it reconstructs images within one point oh nine decibels of Flux's VAE.

scenes.label: on ImgEdit at 2B, with the understanding branch frozen
scenes.say: And it edits well, three point three two on ImgEdit, with its understanding branch frozen. Only the generation side learned.

scenes.text: If one space can serve both seeing and drawing, the pre-trained encoder and decoder stop being necessary and start being constraints.

recap: Patches in and out of one MoT backbone
scenes.say: To recap: no encoder, no VAE, patches through one backbone, and pixels that come back anyway.
